tagline: MADE IN INDONESIA. BUILT FOR THE WORLD.

story.title: Indonesia as a Toyota manufacturing and export base for the world.
story.body: TMMIN is Toyota Motor Corporation’s Indonesian manufacturing subsidiary, producing vehicles, engines, components and production tools. Its official corporate profile highlights five production facilities in Sunter and Karawang, decades of local manufacturing and a large global export footprint.

highlights.title: Sunter + Karawang
highlights.body: Five facilities cover engines, press and casting parts, complete vehicles and production tooling.

highlights.title: Toyota Production System
highlights.body: Jidoka and Just-in-Time underpin a high-precision manufacturing system focused on quality and efficiency.

highlights.title: Global export base
highlights.body: CBU, CKD, engines, components and production tools move from Indonesia to international markets.

highlights.title: Electrified manufacturing
highlights.body: Karawang production includes conventional and hybrid models as Indonesia expands electrified vehicle capability.
